snippet.title: Circuit Overload: Everything Changed in the New Update!
snippet.description:
Circuit Overload’s major overhaul is here. Fly solo or team up with up to four players in a six-stage campaign, discover 36 weapon Fusions, and build your interceptor with a new skill tree.

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4171420/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_desc
Search on Steam: Circuit Overload

What's new in Update 2.2.4:
• Online co-op for up to four players
• A six-stage Operations campaign
• A new skill tree with new abilities and rebalanced progression
• Four new weapons and 36 weapon Fusions
• Two new guardians and reworked returning bosses
• Overhauled ships, enemies, stages, and menus
• Full controller support with Steam Input
• Steam Cloud saves

Pilot an interceptor through the Circuit, a vast energy megastructure trapped in lockdown. Unlock permanent upgrades between runs, experiment with weapon combinations, and push deeper into its defenses.

Returning to Circuit Overload? Bring a friend and see how much has changed.

#CircuitOverload #Roguelike #CoopGaming
